title: What color is your lightsaber? Free Star Wars quiz — cv.cm
description: Free lightsaber color quiz: answer 12 questions to find out whether your blade is blue, green, purple, yellow, white, red, orange or black, and what it says about you. Unofficial fan quiz.
lede: Guardian, sage, rebel or Sith? Answer 12 questions about how you fight, think and choose sides to find out what color your lightsaber would be.
about: In the Star Wars stories, a lightsaber's color is often read as a sign of its wielder: blue for Jedi guardians, green for wise consulars, purple for those who walk a line between light and dark, yellow for sentinels, red for the Sith, white for a blade purified after the dark side, orange for rare independent spirits, and the black blade of the one-of-a-kind Darksaber.

Fans and different stories don't always agree on what each color means, so this quiz uses the most common fan readings. It is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm, not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm or Disney; Star Wars and its characters belong to their owners.

faq.a: In common fan readings: blue is courage and protection, green is wisdom and calm, purple is balance, yellow is vigilance, white is renewal, red is ambition and the dark side, orange is independence, and black (the Darksaber) is leadership.

faq.q: What is the rarest lightsaber color?
faq.a: In the stories, black is unique: there is only one Darksaber. In this quiz, every color is equally likely.
Red blades belong to the Sith in the films, but your result here describes ambition and passion, not evil. Plenty of heroes have a fiery streak.

blue.name: Blue lightsaber
blue.body: You are a guardian: brave, active and quick to defend others. You'd rather act than wait, and you put yourself between danger and the people you care about. Make sure your courage leaves room for patience.

green.name: Green lightsaber
green.body: You are a sage: wise, calm and thoughtful. You'd rather solve a conflict with words than a blade, and you seek to understand before you act. Others come to you for advice.

purple.name: Purple lightsaber
purple.body: You walk the line between light and dark. You know your passions and use them without letting them rule you. Few people can hold that balance; you make it look easy.

yellow.name: Yellow lightsaber
yellow.body: You are a sentinel: watchful, practical and alert to trouble others miss. You prefer to protect quietly from the background, and you're always ready when you're needed.

white.name: White lightsaber
white.body: You have been through hard times and come out stronger. You value fresh starts, forgiveness and doing things your own way, with no master and no grudge. Your path is your own.

red.name: Red lightsaber
red.body: You are passionate, ambitious and powerful. You know what you want and you go after it with everything you have. Make sure your fire serves you and doesn't burn the people around you.

orange.name: Orange lightsaber
orange.body: You are a free spirit: independent, inventive and loyal to your own code. Rules are suggestions to you, and you fight for what you believe in, whichever side it falls on.

black.name: Black lightsaber (Darksaber)
black.body: You are a leader. People follow you, and you take that responsibility seriously. Like the one-of-a-kind Darksaber, you are rare and you protect your people above all.
